title: Parallel lens execution with per-lens read-only copies and two time limits
summary: The reviewer run no longer walks its selected lenses one at a time in a single shared workspace. It now runs them on a fixed thread pool sized by a new `[review] concurrency` setting (default 8), each lens in its own read-only `CleanCopy` of the change, bounded by two new time limits: a per-lens `timeout_seconds` (raised from 300s to 1800s) that also caps the retry, and a whole-run `total_timeout_seconds` (default 2700s) counted from the first lens start. A lens that hits either limit, panics, fails its provider, or cannot build its context is recorded as could-not-run for that lens alone; the other lenses finish. Config validation now refuses zero or over-24-hour timings and names the setting.

nodes.label: review_run::run_reviewer_with
nodes.subtitle: fn run_reviewer_with(req, setup, reviewer)
nodes.summary: Builds the shared change folder once, takes the whole-run deadline, then fans the selected lenses out over a thread pool. Idle reviewers and a failed change folder short-circuit to per-lens records without starting any worker.

nodes.label: run_pool
nodes.subtitle: fn run_pool(count, workers, work)
nodes.summary: A fixed pool of `workers` scoped threads draining a shared VecDeque of lens indexes, writing each LensRun back into its index slot so results keep selection order regardless of completion order.

nodes.label: run_lens
nodes.subtitle: fn run_lens(...) -> LensRun
nodes.summary: One lens's whole life: check the deadline, create a read-only CleanCopy of the change, build the lens context, render the prompt, and run the attempts inside that copy. The copy is dropped when the lens ends.

nodes.label: contain_panic
nodes.subtitle: fn contain_panic(lens, body)
nodes.summary: Wraps a lens body in catch_unwind so a panic becomes a could-not-run record naming the lens and the panic message, instead of unwinding the pool.

nodes.label: deadline_after
nodes.subtitle: fn deadline_after(total) -> Result<Instant, String>
nodes.summary: Turns the whole-run duration into an Instant once, just before the workers start, and refuses a duration too large to add to now, naming total_timeout_seconds.

nodes.label: Attempts::once
nodes.subtitle: fn once(&self, round, critical) -> Attempt
nodes.summary: Gives each attempt the smaller of the per-attempt limit and the time left to the whole-run deadline; a retry shares the same budget. When no time is left it records could-not-run naming the total limit, and limit_reason attributes a timeout to whichever limit bound it.

nodes.label: judge_lens
nodes.subtitle: fn judge_lens(...)
nodes.summary: A lens with a context error now contributes a Judged::missing record before the verdict is returned, so the lens still gets exactly one could-not-run journal event instead of being silently dropped.

nodes.label: CleanCopy
nodes.subtitle: crates/osf/src/clean_copy.rs
nodes.summary: The tracked+untracked copy of the repository. A new read-only constructor shares the copy body with the writable one and then chmods the tree deepest-first; Drop restores write permission before removing the directory.

nodes.label: set_read_only_tree
nodes.subtitle: fn set_read_only_tree(path, read_only)
nodes.summary: Walks a copy children-before-parent, setting files 0o444 and folders 0o555 on Unix (read-only attribute per file elsewhere), so the agent that starts in the copy cannot change it.

nodes.label: ChangeFolder
nodes.subtitle: the diff and commit log file
nodes.summary: The one folder holding the diff and commit log, still created once per reviewer run and shared by every lens; only the per-lens copy moved inside the worker.

nodes.label: reviewers::run_with_retry
nodes.subtitle: fn run_with_retry(...)
nodes.summary: The first run and its retry now share one timeout: the retry is given only the time left since the attempt started, and a retry with no time left is could-not-run rather than a fresh full timeout.

nodes.label: Agent child process
nodes.subtitle: opencode / omp CLI
nodes.summary: The coding-agent command line the reviewer shells out to, run with the per-attempt timeout and the lens's read-only copy as its working directory.

nodes.label: ReviewConfig
nodes.subtitle: [review] section of osf.toml
nodes.summary: Gains concurrency, total_timeout_seconds and a raised timeout_seconds default; validation refuses zero, wrong types and anything above 86400 seconds, naming the setting.

nodes.label: review_config
nodes.subtitle: fn review_config(root) -> Result<ReviewConfig, ConfigError>
nodes.summary: Reads the [review] table and now checks concurrency, timeout_seconds and total_timeout_seconds for zero, type and the 24-hour ceiling before the run starts.

nodes.label: review_run integration tests
nodes.subtitle: crates/osf/tests/review_run.rs
nodes.summary: New end-to-end tests drive fake agents that log nanosecond start/end lines and route by lens name, covering overlap under the concurrency cap, one read-only copy per lens, per-attempt and total limits, retry budgeting, panics, provider failures and the cost ceiling.

edges.label: lenses over workers
edges.summary: The change's centre: the sequential lens loop becomes a bounded thread pool.
Each worker takes the next lens index and runs that lens to completion.

edges.label: create_read_only
edges.summary: Every lens gets its own read-only copy of the change, created inside the worker and dropped when the lens ends.
The read-only constructor chmods the copied tree deepest-first.
The lens's attempts run inside its own copy, bounded by the deadline taken before the pool started.

edges.label: min(per_attempt, remaining)
edges.summary: Each attempt is given the smaller of the per-attempt limit and the time left to the whole-run deadline.
The agent child is still spawned with a timeout and the lens's working directory; only the timeout value now shrinks for a retry.
Every lens reads the same shared diff and commit log file; only the copy is per-lens.

edges.label: concurrency, timeouts
edges.summary: The new concurrency and total timeout, and the raised per-attempt timeout, reach the run through Setup.
The loader validates and fills the new timing fields.
Every pool task is wrapped so a panicking lens becomes a could-not-run record and the pool keeps draining.

edges.label: deadline
edges.summary: The single Instant taken before the pool starts bounds every attempt of every lens.
A context-error lens now yields a Judged::missing record so its could-not-run event survives reduction.
Integration tests assert overlap never exceeds the configured concurrency and that one copy exists per lens.

flows.title: One reviewer run, lenses in parallel
flows.summary: A reviewer run takes its deadline, then runs each selected lens on the pool: a read-only copy per lens, a prompt, and attempts bounded by whichever limit is nearer.

messages.label: deadline_after(total_timeout_seconds)
messages.note: One Instant, taken just before the workers start, bounds every lens.

messages.label: create_read_only(root)
messages.note: A fresh read-only copy per lens, so two lenses never share a working directory.

messages.label: min(per_attempt, remaining)
messages.note: The retry shares the attempt's budget, so it cannot add a second full timeout past the total limit.

messages.label: LensRun into its index slot
messages.note: Results land in selection order even though lenses finish out of order.
